verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: both red circles are pulled away from their dogs and left as empty blobs (one huge circle in the middle with nothing on it), the dogs shrink to tiny thumbnails jammed in a bottom row next to a stray circle and pennant, and the arrow shapes float around without meaning, so the brand's dog-on-circle motif is lost. B keeps each dog on its circle and reflows the layout top to bottom (dog, headline, dog), with the arrow accents tucked into the corners. Its flaws are small: the top dog's ears run off the top of the circle, the lower circle is cut off at the right edge, and the headline block sits a little tight against both dogs.
